proposals.issue_title: Fragile Image Generation & Lack of Resilient Provider Fallback
proposals.current_pain_description: Pipelines crash or produce unusable quality because they rely on single, unstable image APIs (Pollinations, blocked AI Horde, or rate-limited Gemini). There is no auto-fallback mechanism to switch from free providers (Together AI, Cloudflare) to paid PAYG (Runware) when limits are reached.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a unified `UnifiedImageGenerator` class in Python. It tries: 1. Together AI (free Flux-schnell), 2. Cloudflare Workers AI (free), 3. Pollinations (fallback), 4. Runware (paid PAYG, capped at 20€/month using a local state budget file saved in the repo). If a provider returns non-200 or poor quality, it auto-tries the next.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates build failures on GHA, ensures high-quality Flux images, guarantees 0€ cost by default, and stays strictly under the 20€ budget.

proposals.issue_title: Termux Mobile Upload Bottleneck (No Auto-Packaging for Uploads)
proposals.current_pain_description: Hugo operates solely from an Android phone. Downloading loose image files from GitHub to manual upload on Redbubble/KDP is tedious, slow, and prone to file-handling errors on mobile Chrome.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a post-processing step to all asset pipelines that bundles: 1. The final print-ready assets, 2. A pre-formatted `metadata.json` (title, description, tags, keywords optimized for Redbubble/KDP), and 3. A lightweight HTML upload dashboard hosted on GitHub Pages (private or public) that lets Hugo copy-paste titles/tags and download ZIPs directly onto his phone with 1 click.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces manual listing time on mobile from 15 minutes per product to under 3 minutes.

proposals.issue_title: Lack of Inline Visual Quality Audits (Deformed Anatomy/Text in Images)
proposals.current_pain_description: Images are generated and committed directly to the repo without checking if they have visual bugs (e.g., extra fingers, garbled text on cards, messy coloring lines), leading to unsellable products.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate `agent_gemini_quality_check` directly inside the generation loop of each pipeline. After an image is generated, send a low-res version to Gemini 2.5 Flash (which has free multimodal capabilities) with a strict prompt: 'Is this image deformed, does it contain text gibberish, or are lines broken? Answer YES or NO.' If YES, regenerate instantly with a modified prompt seed up to 3 times before failing.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Guarantees 100% sellable visual quality without Hugo having to manually inspect and reject hundreds of generated images.

proposals.issue_title: No GHA State Persistence for Long-Running Book/Asset Compilations
proposals.current_pain_description: Generating a 40-page coloring book takes time. If the GHA run fails at page 35 due to an API timeout, network error, or rate limit, the entire run is lost, wasting API credits (Runware) and execution time.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a checkpoint system. Before generating page N, check if `output/pages/page_N.png` already exists in the workspace or in a cache. Use GitHub Actions `@actions/cache` or commit intermediate steps to a temporary branch so interrupted runs can resume exactly where they failed.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents wasted API costs, saves GitHub Actions runtime, and allows building large-scale books incrementally.

proposals.current_pain_description: A successful design generated for a Redbubble sticker is never reused. The system does not automatically reformat the design into a KDP coloring page, an SVG cut file for Etsy, or a parametric Cults3D lithophane, missing out on massive leverage.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a `cross_pollinate.py` script. When a high-quality vector or high-res raster design is approved: 1. Generate transparent PNG (Redbubble), 2. Convert to monochrome SVG (Etsy/Silhouette), 3. Generate a KDP-ready PDF page with a themed border, 4. Output a simple 3D lithophane STL using a basic Python parametric script. Save all 4 outputs in a single structured product folder.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Multiplies inventory by 4x for the same creative/computational cost per design.

proposals.issue_title: Silent KDP Margin & Bleed Violations in PDF Compilers
proposals.current_pain_description: Books compiled via custom python-reportlab or FPDF scripts often fail Amazon KDP's strict manual review because illustrations extend into the gutter or margins, delaying publication by weeks.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a standardized KDP PDF compiler utility with hardcoded safety margins (e.g., 0.25' outer margins, 0.375' gutter for 40+ pages). Add an automated test that overlays a semi-transparent 'safe-zone' mask on sample pages to visually confirm that no critical artwork elements are cut off.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Avoids frustrating KDP upload rejections and ensures 100% pass rate on KDP's print-ready previewer.
